nodes.label: PHP mail() Contact Form Handler
nodes.rationale: Screenshot shows the mail.php handler pattern to replicate: it collects $_POST fields (name, email, phone, message), builds formcontent and a From mailheader, then calls mail($recipient, $subject, $formcontent, $mailheader) and require_once('thank-you.html'); the red arrow annotation 'this here you personal mail use' marks the $recipient variable line as the single place the integrator must set their own email address when mailing from the contact form.

nodes.label: Blog post thumbnail/featured-image placeholders
nodes.rationale: The blog_img01-03 assets ship as deliberately blank gray rectangles in both a large (~800x540) and small (~400x270) rendition. Their purpose is to reserve fixed layout space for each blog post's featured image so the grid/list stays visually stable before real content images are uploaded — a common template-filler pattern ensuring thumbnails remain aligned and uniformly sized.

nodes.label: Comment-section avatar placeholders
nodes.rationale: avatar.png, c_01.png, c_02.png and c_03.png are uniform gray circles used as default/sample commenter avatars. Their purpose is to provide a neutral fallback so the comment thread demonstrates its circular avatar layout without shipping identifiable people photos — privacy-safe sample data for the comment UI.

nodes.label: Hero slider homepage pattern
nodes.rationale: The template's homepage opens with a full-width hero slider built from layered background images plus per-slide foreground artwork — a common education-site landing pattern relevant to the academic portal design.

nodes.label: Qeducato line-art icon system (SVE icons)
nodes.rationale: Consistent thin-stroke coral line-art icons covering education subjects and facilities (e-learning laptop, library books, gym equipment), used for feature/category lists in the template.

nodes.label: sve-icon5.png
nodes.rationale: Appears blank/white in render; likely a white or transparent-serving feature icon from the SVE icon set, used as a decorative feature-list icon in the Qeducato template. AMBIGUOUS: actual glyph not visible.

nodes.label: sve-icon6.png
nodes.rationale: Appears blank/white in render; likely a white or transparent feature icon from the SVE icon set. AMBIGUOUS: actual glyph not visible.

nodes.label: sve-icon7.png — online learning icon
nodes.rationale: Orange line-art icon of a laptop topped by a graduation cap with a tassel — represents e-learning / online classes. Used as a feature or course-category icon in the Qeducato education template.

nodes.label: sve-icon8.png — open books icon
nodes.rationale: Orange line-art icon of open books — represents library / study resources in the Qeducato template icon set.

nodes.label: sve-icon9.png — gym fitness icon
nodes.rationale: Orange line-art icon of a kettlebell and dumbbell — represents gym / sports-facility or fitness course category in the Qeducato template icon set.

nodes.label: f_logo.png (footer logo)
nodes.rationale: Appears blank/white in render — a light/white variant of the Qeducato logo intended for use on dark footer backgrounds. AMBIGUOUS: glyph not visible due to white-on-white rendering.

nodes.label: Qeducato brand logo
nodes.rationale: Primary wordmark 'QEDUCATO' with a graduation-cap 'Q' monogram; navy-blue 'QEDU' plus coral/orange 'CATO'. Establishes the template's two-color brand palette (dark navy + coral) and its graduation-cap visual motif.

nodes.label: slider_bg_01.png
nodes.rationale: Second wide hero-slide background asset for the slider; renders as plain gray placeholder. AMBIGUOUS: no visible content, likely a subtle background layer.

nodes.label: slider_bg.png
nodes.rationale: Wide (~1920px) hero-slide background asset for the Qeducato template slider; renders as plain gray, suggesting a solid/placeholder backdrop or background layer that overlays/behind slider text. AMBIGUOUS: no visible content.

nodes.label: slider_img02.png
nodes.rationale: Slider illustration image (img02) intended as foreground artwork for slide 2 of the hero slider; renders as plain gray placeholder. AMBIGUOUS: no visible content.
